::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 5th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.
:::

My dear [Mr Moor](people/person_1046.qmd)

I enclose the £1  I fancied I had heard that [Miss Le Gallais](people/person_855.qmd) had made her start in life.

Will you tell [Selina](people/person_1048.qmd) that I am sending on the magazine today[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Moor's daughter Selina seems to have been the editor of a magazine, perhaps the Ampfield Parish Magazine.
